items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:75:1
items.html: The final Hey of the general SAG, etc., is like the first Hey, which are three Heys, etc., in the secret of internality; there is also another set in the secret of externality: For this bottom Hey is the discernment of Nukva to ZA of SAG, and she too is a complete Partzuf of RTS [Rosh-Toch-Sof], hinted at in three Heys, like the first Hey, which are HBD, HGT, NHY. And likewise she is necessarily reckoned to have internality, namely the RTS of her own structure, and three Heys of externality, which are the NHY that clothe in the HGT-NHY of the lower one below her — namely the two last Heys — and also the discernment of NHY of the Mochin of GAR for the lower one, which is the discernment of the simple Hey. So these are three discernments of garments of Mochin that clothe in the RTS of the lower one, which are at a lower discernment than the screen and coarseness of the bottom Hey of SAG, since it is lower than her — for this is the rule, that every lower one, with respect to the one above it, is always at a lower discernment than it, since the ladder of degrees never changes, as above, page 898, the passage beginning “And one must.” And it is known that the lower one to the bottom Hey of SAG is ZA of the general Atzilut.
